name: Beijing Kingsoft Office Software, Inc.
summary: Beijing Kingsoft Office Software, Inc. provides office software products and services in China and internationally. It offers WPS Office for Windows, Mac, Android, iOS, Linux, HarmonyOS, Enterprise PC version, and Enterprise Mobile Version; cloud office products comprising Kingsoft Docts, WPS Collaboration, WPS Email, WPS Calendar, and WPS Meeting; and other products, including WPS AIPPT, WPS Browser Assistant, WPS PDF Standalone Version, WPS PDF Professional Edition, Kingsoft PowerWord, Kingsoft PowerWord Enterprise Edition, WPS Dark Horse Proofreader, and Kingsoft Typing Tutor.
